==== generated/signing.graph.md
# Signing capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc:44"]
    m0["kernel/signed-kernel"]
    m1["drivers/kvmfr"]
    base -->|"initramfs-generation"| m0
    m0 -->|"/usr/libexec/kernel-devel-helpers.sh, kernel-devel"| m1
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/usr/libexec/kernel-devel-helpers.sh` | file, build only | `kernel/signed-kernel` | `drivers/kvmfr` |  |
| `/usr/share/secureboot/sb_cert.der` | file | `kernel/signed-kernel` |  |  |
| `initramfs-generation` | capability | `base` | `kernel/signed-kernel` |  |
| `kernel-devel` | capability | `kernel/signed-kernel` | `drivers/kvmfr` |  |
| `rechunking` | capability | `base` |  |  |
